relay.name: Relay
relay.voice: A trace you can read. An action you can review.
principles: Treat evidence as a first-class object.
Keep agent activity separate from human approval.
Use colour for state, not atmosphere.

references.name: Linear · agents
references.note: Visual reference for precise dark surfaces, restrained accents and visible agent activity. Relay’s incident workflow is an original concept.

references.name: Linear · AI
references.note: Reference for contextual agent work and reviewable activity.

hero.alt: A dark desktop incident-response workspace with an investigation timeline, a service dependency graph and a rollback inspector requiring human approval.
hero.caption: Relay’s incident workspace: an evidence timeline, service map and human-approved rollback. Generated interface exploration.

relay.description: A dark desktop incident-response workspace with an investigation timeline, a service dependency graph and a rollback inspector requiring human approval.
principleDetails: A claim should travel with a source identifier, retrieval context and a clear route to inspect it.
A proposal is not an execution. Review remains visible, and changed arguments invalidate approval.
Mint marks verified evidence, lavender marks a reviewable action, and the neutral surface carries everything else.

problem.alt: A Relay incident triage screen with alert feed, deployment history, trace explorer and incident channel.
problem.caption: The starting point: four sources, conflicting signals, one on-call engineer. Relay is an incident-response tool for engineering teams. Generated interface exploration.

solution.alt: Relay rollback review with cited evidence, a review checkpoint and a production permission boundary.
solution.caption: The proposed interaction: inspect the exact rollback and its sources before granting single-use approval. Generated interface exploration.

impact.alt: Relay evaluation lab showing six synthetic fixtures and a stale-runbook recovery trace.
impact.caption: An evaluation interface for six synthetic policy cases. These are illustrative fixture results, not production performance. Generated interface exploration.

how-i-used-ai.alt: Relay agent contract showing prompt rules, a context manifest and permission-scoped MCP tools.
how-i-used-ai.caption: AI design made inspectable: prompt rules, source freshness, tool permissions and a bounded execution budget. Generated interface exploration.

lessons.alt: Relay safe-stop screen withholding a proposal because the runbook is expired and offering context refresh or human handoff.
lessons.caption: A recovery exploration: make the missing evidence and next safe action explicit. The working demo uses freshness checks rather than confidence scores. Generated interface exploration.

tandem.name: Tandem
tandem.thesis: Warm, practical software for the people doing the shift.
tandem.voice: Life happens. Your schedule can keep up.
principles: Show the shift before asking for a decision.
Explain eligibility without exposing private availability.
Keep a pending request visibly different from a confirmed swap.

references.name: Deputy
references.note: Qualified cover, colleague consent and manager approval in a mobile scheduling flow.

hero.alt: Two coordinated mobile scheduling screens: a weekly shift view and a colleague-selection flow, with eligibility checks and an explicit pending-approval message.
hero.caption: Generated product interface · Tandem

tandem.description: Two coordinated mobile scheduling screens: a weekly shift view and a colleague-selection flow, with eligibility checks and an explicit pending-approval message.
principleDetails: Date, hours and role travel with the request so both people know what they are agreeing to.
Show whether a colleague can cover the shift without exposing private roster details.
The original assignment stays in force until consent and review are complete.

formwork.name: Formwork
formwork.thesis: An exact, inspectable bridge between a design choice and its implementation.
principles: Expose the component contract beside the specimen.
Name supported variations instead of offering arbitrary values.
Make accessibility and loading states part of the default view.

references.name: Storybook
references.note: A component canvas, argument controls and inspectable implementation documentation.

hero.alt: A blue and white component workbench with a navigation tree, three button states, a properties inspector, React code and an accessibility checklist.
hero.caption: Generated product interface · Formwork

formwork.description: A blue and white component workbench with a navigation tree, three button states, a properties inspector, React code and an accessibility checklist.
principleDetails: A component is useful when its states, properties and implementation can be examined together.
A limited set of named variations helps teams reuse the component without rebuilding the system.
Keyboard, semantics and status feedback belong alongside the default visual specimen.

common-ground.name: Common Ground
common-ground.thesis: A patient editorial space that keeps observations close to their sources.
common-ground.voice: A better question changes the work.
principles: Keep observation separate from interpretation.
Carry source IDs and counterexamples into synthesis.
Use photography as context, never as proof of fieldwork.

references.name: Dovetail
references.note: Linked research evidence, source retrieval and traceable synthesis across a study.

hero.alt: A warm paper-toned research notebook showing a home-energy study, source excerpts grouped by trust, permission and timing, and a traceable interpretation panel.
hero.caption: Generated product interface · Common Ground

common-ground.description: A warm paper-toned research notebook showing a home-energy study, source excerpts grouped by trust, permission and timing, and a traceable interpretation panel.
principleDetails: A source excerpt and a researcher’s explanation are different objects and should remain distinguishable.
A strong synthesis can be retraced to evidence, including material that challenges the preferred interpretation.
The generated house image establishes the study’s setting; participant evidence requires actual research.

plainly.name: Plainly
plainly.thesis: An accessible service voice that gives people a clear next step.
principles: Explain the consequence before the commitment.
Use one clear action and a practical route to a person.
Test understanding instead of asking which wording people prefer.

references.name: Monzo
references.note: Plain, considerate language and practical help routes for people worried about money.

hero.alt: A calm blue utility support portal with three help routes, a contact-request panel and clear wording that the request does not commit the person to a payment plan.
hero.caption: Generated product interface · Plainly

plainly.description: A calm blue utility support portal with three help routes, a contact-request panel and clear wording that the request does not commit the person to a payment plan.
principleDetails: Before someone continues, the interface explains what will change and what will not.
The service offers a finite next step and a route to a person when the available options do not fit.
Good wording helps a person explain the next step in their own words, not simply prefer its tone.

waypoint.name: Waypoint
waypoint.thesis: A bold, legible strategy that makes ownership and trade-offs tangible.
waypoint.sample: A direction teams can act on.
principles: Name the owner and the decision that needs to be made.
Fund adoption and integration alongside the shared platform.
Make the work being deferred as visible as the chosen work.

references.name: Jira Product Discovery
references.note: Explicit prioritisation, ownership and a roadmap connected to delivery.

hero.alt: A yellow and ink strategy workspace with Now, Next and Later initiatives, a three-lane 90-day roadmap and a decision record explaining what the team will defer.
hero.caption: Generated product interface · Waypoint

waypoint.description: A yellow and ink strategy workspace with Now, Next and Later initiatives, a three-lane 90-day roadmap and a decision record explaining what the team will defer.
principleDetails: A strategy becomes actionable when someone owns the decision and knows when it will be reviewed.
Shared foundations need migration, squad integration and support capacity; those costs are part of the bet.
A decision record explains which work moves later and why, making prioritisation accountable.

afterhours.name: Afterhours
afterhours.thesis: Cinema photography and editorial type, held together by a practical programme.
principles: Let the film earn attention; keep showtimes easy to scan.
Give editorial titles scale and utility labels restraint.
Preserve a clear handoff from discovery to ticketing.

references.name: Everyman Cinema
references.note: Venue-based film discovery and direct access to booking.

references.name: MUBI
references.note: A photography-led editorial approach to discovering cinema.

hero.alt: An ink-black and oxblood cinema programme featuring a rain-lit Melbourne tram film still, a large film title and an adjacent screening selector with a clear booking action.
hero.caption: Generated product interface · Afterhours

afterhours.description: An ink-black and oxblood cinema programme featuring a rain-lit Melbourne tram film still, a large film title and an adjacent screening selector with a clear booking action.
principleDetails: Film photography sets the mood while dates, durations and screening times remain practical.
Expressive display typography belongs with the programme, while navigation and booking text stay quiet.
The selected film and screening must survive the transition into the ticketing service.
